chunks: A dirham spent in hajj is better than a million dirhams spent elsewhere. And a dirham that reaches the Imam is like a million dirhams spent in hajj.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, whose receipt of wealth is described as especially virtuous
key_terms.الْحَجِّ: hajj, the pilgrimage whose expenditure is described as highly meritorious
key_terms.حَجٍّ: hajj; used again to compare the magnitude of reward
key_terms.خَيْرٌ: better; indicating greater virtue and reward
key_terms.دِرْهَمًا: a unit of money; a dirham spent in devotion

ai.seo_question: What is the reward of spending wealth on hajj and giving to the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the immense merit of spending wealth in hajj and highlights the exceptional virtue of giving to the Imam. It presents both acts as possessing multiplied spiritual value beyond ordinary expenditure.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "A dirham spent on Hajj is better than a million dirhams spent elsewhere. And a dirham that reaches the Imam is equivalent to a million dirhams spent on Hajj."
